text:
[Council File 26-1058]
Motion (Rodriguez – Jurado) relative to updating protocols, policies, and requirements governing the use of parks and recreational facilities for private use and events that charge admission or other fees to the public, and establishing an opportunity for formal public review.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Updating protocols and policies for private use and events charging admission in city parks and recreational facilities.

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee approved item(s) (Sep 16, 2026)
